crates_created.name: oya-foundry-fitness-upstream-api-drift-kernel
crates_created.bnf_justification: oya-<microservice:foundry>-<bc:fitness-upstream-api-drift>-<layer:kernel>; v4.1 conformant — follows the established `oya-foundry-fitness-*-kernel` pattern (e.g., oya-foundry-fitness-claim-ceiling-kernel); layer=kernel: pure value types + detect_drift decision function; no I/O.
crates_created.purpose: Diff a locally pinned adapter contract fingerprint vs the upstream canonical fingerprint and classify findings (BREAKING / NON_BREAKING / ADDITIVE). JSON contract fingerprints — NOT OpenAPI YAML — per workspace constraint (validators reject incomplete schemas).
crates_created.linus_good_taste: Providers are rows in a static `UpstreamRegistry` table; `detect_drift` is one function that iterates the table. Adding Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, or a future provider is a row addition, not a code addition.

symbols_shipped: DriftEntry, DriftKind (14 variants covering operation/method/path/field/enum/status changes)
ccproxy_parity: Net-new vs ccproxy-api — ccproxy has no automated upstream-drift lane. This IP closes that gap.
